name: Tigmanshu Dhulia
bio: Tigmanshu Dhulia is an Indian film dialogue writer, director, actor, screenwriter, producer and casting director known for his works in Hindi cinema and Television.

credits.title: Welcome to Bajrangpur
credits.overview: A drama film directed by Ashish Kumar Dubey and Vir Mahajan.

credits.title: Pratap
credits.overview: A decorated encounter specialist is imprisoned for murder, leading to a journey of self-discovery revealing that his arrest is retribution tied to his past.

credits.title: Pati Patni Aur Woh Do
credits.overview: A seemingly perfect marriage in Prayagraj takes an unexpected turn when one decision leads to a chain of misunderstandings, suspicion, and comedic chaos.

credits.title: The Promise
credits.overview: Former bartender George Batra awaits his lost love's return after 20 years, hoping to reunite at the bar where they met and parted. As he waits for their fated reunion, he uncovers what he left behind.

credits.title: Ghamasaan
credits.overview: Set in the Hindi heartland, the story follows a cat and mouse chase against a ruthless dacoit. An honest IPS officer is determined to hunt him down, corrupt politicians notwithstanding.

credits.title: Holy Cow
credits.overview: The story of how Salim's cow, Ruksar, goes missing and he starts searching for it at night.

credits.title: Raat Akeli Hai
credits.overview: When a newly married landlord is murdered, a misfit cop’s investigation is complicated by the victim’s secretive family and his own conflicted heart.

credits.title: Yaara
credits.overview: Story of 'Chaukdi Gang' and the two men who helped build this gang played by Vidyut Jammwal and Amit Sadh. This gang of four which includes Vijay Varma, is nabbed by the police and serve their time in jail. credits.title: The Man Who Feels No Pain
credits.overview: Leveraging his ability to withstand pain, a young man trains to follow in the footsteps of his martial arts hero.

credits.title: Milan Talkies
credits.overview: Anirudh aka Anu lives in Allahabad and along with his friends, he makes local movies and also runs a gang that lets students cheat in exams. His life changes completely when he meets Maithili, whose father hires Anu to help her clear her exams.

credits.title: Zero
credits.overview: Short in stature but big on love, a bachelor meets two very different women who broaden his horizons and help him find purpose in life.

credits.title: Baarish Aur Chowmein
credits.overview: The story revolves around Siraj who is unable to rent a house in Mumbai as not many are willing to accommodate a Muslim. So, he hides his true identity and finds a home, where he falls in love with the landlord's daughter, Neelu. Will Siraj be honest and disclose his secret to Neelu?

credits.title: Saheb, Biwi Aur Gangster 3
credits.overview: It’s the third edition of Saheb, Biwi Aur Gangster series where it’s survival of the wittiest and the wealthiest. Will the royal couple Madhavi Devi and Aditya Pratap Singh live to tell the tale of relentless plotting, scheming and backstabbing?

credits.title: Raag Desh
credits.overview: Three officers of the Indian National Army are on trial for treason. An ailing lawyer must help them face the consequence of their courage.

credits.title: Hero
credits.overview: After meeting the chief of police's pretty daughter, a gangster kidnaps the girl. During the journey they fall in love and the gangster decides to set her free.

credits.title: Manjhi: The Mountain Man
credits.overview: After his wife passes away trying to cross a mountain, Manjhi, out of sheer rage, sets on a quest to carve a road through the treacherous mountain.

credits.title: The Shaukeens
credits.overview: Three friends in their 60s try to do everything that they couldn't do in their younger days - before death arrives.

credits.title: Revolver Rani
credits.overview: Alka Singh, the leader of a political party, and her obsessive love for Rohan Mehra, a rising star of Bollywood.

credits.title: Bullett Raja
credits.overview: A common man who transforms into a gangster revolts against the very system he once obediently followed by declaring war on the police, the government, and the industrialists.

credits.title: Shahid
credits.overview: A story based on real-life human-rights and criminal lawyer, Shahid Azmi, who was slain while defending the wrongly accused by the law in terrorist activities.

credits.title: Saheb Biwi Aur Gangster Returns
credits.overview: The Royal Scandal, the war for power and fight for money continues with the return of Saheb Biwi Aur Gangster. Aditya Pratap Singh is crippled and is trying to recover from the physical disability and his wifes betrayal. credits.overview: After the death of his father and brother Danish, Faizal Khan vows to take revenge by destroying Ramadhir Singh's gang.

credits.title: Gangs of Wasseypur - Part 1
credits.overview: In 1970s India, Sardar Khan vows to take revenge on the man who killed his father decades earlier.

credits.title: Paan Singh Tomar
credits.overview: Paan Singh Tomar goes from celebrated runner to star brigand and rebel when life after sports fails to unfold as planned.

credits.overview: After the death of his first wife, wealthy Raja Aditya Pratap Singh, re-marries another woman, simply known as Chhoti Rani, who subsequently becomes mentally unstable. credits.overview: Hanumant Singh is the quirky cop in the police department. He is a man of action who delivers most of the time but he has unusual ways to accomplish his mission. credits.title: Charas: A Joint Effort
credits.overview: A police officer gets embroiled in a deadly game with drug mafia, while searching for his long lost friend from London.

credits.title: Haasil
credits.overview: Anirudhh, a law-abiding college student, in love with Niharika, gets caught up in college politics and crime, and must fight it out for himself, when friends turn into foes.

credits.title: Ek Shaam Ki Mulakaat
credits.overview: Newly weds move into a building owned by another couple. What follows is subtle sexual tension between Irrfan and Shivpuri’s characters and an unexpected twist.

credits.title: Fursat Mein
credits.overview: Irrfan plays an eccentric senior citizen who goes out of his way to protect whoever he feels is being oppressed. His tactics include using fake visiting cards to intimidate people, much to the chagrin of his daughter.

credits.title: Bhoron Ne Khilaya Phool
credits.overview: The men of a neighbourhood compete to win over a young woman.

credits.title: Dil Se..
credits.overview: Journalist Amar falls for a mysterious woman on an assignment, but she does not reciprocate his feelings. However, when Amar is about to get married, the woman shows up at his doorstep asking for help.

credits.title: Stiff Upper Lips
credits.overview: Stiff Upper Lips is a broad parody of British period films, especially the lavish Merchant-Ivory productions of the 'eighties and early 'nineties.
